about_the_game:
Jammer Dash is a fast-paced rhythm 2D platformer where you control a lazer and destroy cubes to the beat of the music!

Features

  • Workshop - Build your own levels and upload them via Steam Workshop

  • 5 base levels - Learn the gameplay of Jammer Dash with 5 custom-made songs!

  • 6 lanes - You can destroy cubes in 6 different lanes! The simple controls allow for quick learning of the gameplay!
